sources.title: wd-swinv2-tagger-v3 — Use Cases, Pros & Cons | AI Tools Directory
sources.snippet: WD SwinV2 Tagger v3 is SmilingWolf's third-generation image tagger using a SwinTransformerV2 backbone, trained on large Danbooru image-tag pairs. It predicts anime illustration tags across character, general, and rating categories.
